YOUR WORKING DIRECTORY IS `/opt/nxeon-agent-redesign` (git worktree, branch agent/redesign) of the Nxeon shared-hosting platform (Next.js 15 App Router + Tailwind + Prisma). Do ALL work there. NEVER touch /opt/nxeon or other /opt/nxeon-* worktrees. `cd /opt/nxeon-agent-redesign` first. node_modules is symlinked; tsc/build work.

# CONTEXT: this is a REDO. The prior hosting console (`components/customer/hosting/HostingConsole.tsx`) was rejected as "AI slop": it used emojis as icons, invented bespoke CSS/fonts instead of the portal's design system, had a stripped-down website view, no website thumbnails, and every website still revolved around a "primary domain." Fix ALL of that.

# NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES (the whole point of this redo)
1. **NO EMOJIS anywhere in the UI.** Not in nav, cards, buttons, stats, activity — nowhere.
2. **Use the portal's REAL design system, not invented CSS:**
   - Components in `components/ui/primitives.tsx`: `PageHeader`, `StatCard`, `StatusDot`, `Badge`, `EmptyState`, `fmtBytes`, `fmtMoney`, `timeAgo`. USE THEM.
   - The global CSS utility classes in `app/globals.css`: `.card`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-danger`, `.input`, `.label`. USE THESE for cards/buttons/inputs — do NOT hand-roll card/button CSS.
   - Fonts are already Geist Sans / Geist Mono globally (next/font). Do NOT set font-family. Use mono ONLY for genuinely technical values (hostnames in tech contexts, doc roots) — not for headings/labels.
   - Match the visual house style of the existing VPS panels — read `components/customer/ServerTabs.tsx`, `ServersList.tsx`, `ServerAccess.tsx` and mirror their card/spacing/typography conventions so hosting feels like the same product.
3. **Real icons, not emojis.** The portal has no icon library and uses inline `<svg>`. Create `components/ui/Icon.tsx`: a single `<Icon name=... size=... />` component with a map of clean inline SVG glyphs (stroke, `currentColor`, 24 viewBox, stroke-width ~1.75, round caps). Provide at least: globe, grid, server, database, mail, folder, shield, lock, activity, clock, plus, settings, chevron-right, chevron-down, trash, external-link, upload, hard-drive, cpu, arrow-up, search, more-horizontal, check, refresh, image, star, key. Use it everywhere the old code used an emoji.
4. **App logos, not emojis/letters.** Use `components/ui/AppLogo.tsx` (`<AppLogo family="wordpress" size=.. />`) for app badges — `/public/logos/wordpress.svg` etc. exist. For WooCommerce map to the wordpress logo (or add `public/logos/woocommerce.svg` if you have a clean one). Static sites get an Icon (globe/file), not an emoji.

# STUDY THE TARGET
The user provided reference screenshots of a hosting console: a plan header with action buttons, a plan selector, a row of resource stat-cards, a **website grid where each card has a THUMBNAIL/screenshot** of the site + name + status badges + app + metrics + Manage, and a bottom row (Recent Activity / Plan Information / Resource Usage), plus a right rail. Match that STRUCTURE, rendered in the portal's real style. (There is no saved screenshot file — build from this description + the reference of the existing portal panels.)

# WHAT TO BUILD
Reshape the plan console (`app/dashboard/hosting/[id]/page.tsx` + rewrite/replace `HostingConsole.tsx`). Reuse the existing WORKING panels as section content (do not rebuild their internals): `FileManager`, `DatabasesPanel`, `Backups`, `EmailTab`, `SubdomainsPanel`/`AddonDomainsPanel`, `AppInstaller`, `CronPanel`, `PhpSwitcher`, `HostingUpgradePanel`, `AppCredentials`. Read `lib/actions-hosting.ts` for the real actions (`toView`/`HostingAccountView`, `listWebsites`, `listHostingTaskLog`, `getHostingAppCredentials`, install/set-primary/delete, etc.).

1. **Plan console (default view):** `PageHeader` with the plan `displayName` (inline rename via `renameHostingAccount`) + tier `Badge` + `StatusDot`; ONE each of Add Website / Upgrade Plan / Upgrade Storage. A row of plan-scoped resource `StatCard`s (Websites, Storage, Databases, Emails, Backups) with live counts that click through to that section. A **website grid** from `listWebsites`. Bottom row: Recent Activity (`listHostingTaskLog`), ONE merged Plan card, Resource Usage (real storage/inode/db data only — NO fake CPU/memory). NO "Contact Support" button/card anywhere. A right rail only if it carries non-redundant content (go-live/DNS status). Cut the redundancy (single Upgrade/Add entries).
2. **Website cards with THUMBNAILS:** each website card shows a real thumbnail preview. Implement thumbnails: (a) a custom thumbnail the customer can UPLOAD (add storage for it — mirror the board-attachment upload pattern in `app/api/board/attachments/route.ts`; add a nullable thumbnail reference to the website — a small `HostingWebsiteMeta` table keyed by (accountId, siteRef) is cleanest, or a nullable column per site table — your call, keep it clean + prisma db push compatible), served via an owner-guarded route; and (b) a tasteful branded PLACEHOLDER when none exists (a subtle gradient + the AppLogo + the hostname in the portal style — NOT an emoji). Add an "Upload thumbnail" affordance on the website detail. (A live auto-screenshot service is out of scope — placeholder + custom upload only.)
3. **Websites are INDEPENDENT PEERS — kill the primary-domain-centrism:**
   - The per-website detail view must be fully SELF-CONTAINED: its own domain, app, files, SSL, stats — with NO framing that it hangs off a primary. Remove "primary vs non-primary" language from the per-site UI (a small "Primary" badge on the card is fine; the detail page must not revolve around it).
   - The **Add Website** flow must create a TRUE independent website: either (a) the customer's own domain (addon domain — already independent), or (b) a free Nxeon subdomain that is INDEPENDENT — i.e. `chosenlabel.sites.nxeon.cloud` at the base zone (`HOSTING_SUBDOMAIN_BASE`), with its OWN docroot — NOT `label.{account.primaryDomain}`. Today `createSubdomain` nests under `a.primaryDomain` (see lib/actions-hosting.ts) — that is the bug. Add a clean path (new action + reuse the addon-domain provisioning machinery: own docroot + vhost + wildcard SSL already covers `*.sites.nxeon.cloud`) so a free-subdomain website is a first-class independent site. Keep legacy nested subdomains working (back-compat); validate + guard cross-tenant hostname claims exactly like the existing code.
4. **Rich website Overview** (the detail's default tab): thumbnail/preview, an App card (real AppLogo + version + admin-login credential row for WordPress), a Stats card (storage, PHP, databases, SSL, docroot), Quick actions (Icon-led: File manager, Databases, Email, SSL & domains, Delete), and Recent activity for that site. Then sub-tabs: Overview, App, Files, Domains & SSL, Email, Databases, Logs, Settings — all scoped to that ONE site, reusing existing per-site capabilities (`installWordPress(accountId, target)`, FileManager `initialPath`, set-primary/delete). Do NOT leave it stripped.

# HARD REQUIREMENTS
- Preserve every existing feature + ownership/security guard; nothing that works today may break.
- Real data only (no mock data). 
- `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. After any schema change run `npx prisma generate` first.
- FULL build MUST pass (catches 'use server' + boundary errors tsc misses):
  `export $(grep -E '^DATABASE_URL=' /opt/nxeon-staging/.env | xargs) && npm run build` → must reach "Compiled successfully" AND generate all pages, exit 0.
- `npx tsx --test test/hosting.test.ts` → no NEW failures (pre-existing `fpm pool` failure is fine).

# DELIVERABLE
Commit to agent/redesign (clear message). Do NOT push/deploy. Report: the new component/route structure, the Icon set + confirmation NO emojis remain in the hosting UI (grep your output for emoji and report clean), how thumbnails are stored/served/uploaded, EXACTLY how independent free-subdomain websites are created now (the primary-centrism fix) + back-compat, which panels you reused, schema changes, and confirmation tsc + full build + tests pass. List all shared-file edits.

Committed. Here's the report.

## What was built

Full redo of the hosting console on branch `agent/redesign` (commit `83a51ed`), addressing every "AI slop" complaint.

### New component/route structure
- **`components/ui/Icon.tsx`** (new): single `<Icon name= size= />` component, a dependency-free map of 30 clean inline-SVG glyphs (stroke, `currentColor`, 24 viewBox, stroke-width 1.75, round caps) — includes all requested names plus `file`, `pencil`, `terminal`. Used everywhere the old code had an emoji.
- **`components/customer/hosting/HostingConsole.tsx`** (rewritten): plan console + self-contained website detail, built on `PageHeader`/`StatCard`/`StatusDot`/`Badge`/`fmtBytes`/`timeAgo` and the global `.card`/`.btn-*`/`.input`/`.label` classes. Mono only for technical values (hostnames, docroots).
- **`app/api/hosting/[id]/thumbnail/route.ts`** (new): owner-guarded GET (serve) + POST (upload), `?site=<siteRef>`.
- **`lib/hosting-thumb.ts`** (new): upload dir + siteRef validation.

### Icon set + emoji confirmation
Emoji scan of the rebuilt console, Icon, and thumbnail route/lib is **CLEAN** — no true emoji. The only pictograph-range matches were two typographic `→` arrows (one code comment, one "A record → IP" DNS instruction), which are not emoji. App badges use real `AppLogo` brand SVGs (WordPress/WooCommerce/Ghost/Nextcloud/etc.); static sites and unknown apps get an `<Icon>` (globe/grid), never an emoji or a bare letter.

### Thumbnails
Stored via a new `HostingWebsiteMeta` table keyed `@@unique([accountId, siteRef])` where `siteRef` is the website's stable key (`primary` | `subdomain:<id>` | `addon:<id>`). Uploads mirror the board-attachment pattern: image byte-sniffed (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WEBP, SVG rejected), written under `HOSTING_UPLOAD_DIR`, served owner-guarded with `nosniff` + locked CSP. `listWebsites` now returns `thumbnailAt`; cards render the upload (cache-busted) or a branded gradient + AppLogo + hostname **placeholder**. Site detail has Upload/Replace/Remove (`removeHostingThumbnail` action).

### Primary-centrism fix (independent free subdomains)
New action **`createFreeSubdomainSite(accountId, label)`**: creates `<label>.<HOSTING_SUBDOMAIN_BASE>` at the **base zone** (not `<label>.<primaryDomain>`) as a `HostingAddonDomain` row — reusing the addon-domain machinery so it gets its **own docroot** (`domains/<fqdn>/public_html`), its own vhost (`CREATE_ADDON_DOMAIN` task), and automatic wildcard HTTPS. Same atomic `UNIQUE(hostname)` claim + maxSites cap as every other path. The **Add Website** modal offers "Free Nxeon subdomain" (live availability check) or "Your own domain" (addon) — both independent. Legacy `createSubdomain` (nested) is untouched for **back-compat**. `listWebsites` labels base-zone addon rows as free subdomains; per-site detail is fully self-contained (no "primary vs non-primary" framing; "Primary" is just a small card badge).

### Panels reused verbatim
`FileManager`, `DatabasesPanel`, `Backups`, `EmailTab`, `SubdomainsPanel`, `AddonDomainsPanel`, `CronPanel`, `PhpSwitcher`, `HostingUpgradePanel`, `AppCredentials`, plus `QuotaTile` from `shared`. Removed the Contact-support card; single Add/Upgrade-plan/Upgrade-storage entries; right rail keeps only the non-redundant go-live/DNS/SFTP card.

### Schema changes
Added `model HostingWebsiteMeta` + `websiteMeta` back-relation on `HostingAccount`. Additive and `prisma db push`-compatible (applied at deploy, same pattern as other additive columns in this repo; I did not push to the shared staging DB).

- `lib/actions-hosting.ts` — added `createFreeSubdomainSite`, `removeHostingThumbnail`; `HostingWebsiteView.thumbnailAt` + `HostingAccountView.subdomainBase`; `listWebsites` joins thumbnails and flags free-subdomain addons.
- `components/ui/AppLogo.tsx` — `woocommerce`→`wordpress` alias.
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — the new model + relation.
